text:
Sara: Heads-up: were planning a rebuild to remove privsep helper and the legacy init shim from base images. Aim: non-privileged runtime by default, smaller attack surface. Need to align RBAC, KMS signing, and audit pipeline before we flip production.

Mike: Ill own RBAC. Which service accounts need what? list of repos to update?

Sara: Builders (image-builder-sa) need an assume-role for signing and permission to use the KMS envelope key. Repos: infra/images, infra/image-bakes, services/*-docker. Also Buildkite pipeline changes so the signing step uses short-lived tokens only.

Jen: For audit, push structured events to kafka topic `audit.images`. Minimal fields: image_name, digest, signer, build_id, cosign_key_version, env, phase. Downstream OLAP will join for investigations.

Kevin: KMS path: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/image-signer. Cosign will hold wrapped key material in CI. Key rotation window: 14 days. We need a blocker if rotation occurs mid-rollout.

Sara: Plan sketch: 1) RBAC PR for CI assume-role 2) CI: cosign via KMS envelope 3) Emit audit.images events (retention 1y) 4) Staging canary then phased prod rollout. Owners: RBAC=@Mike, CI=@Jen, Audit=@Lena.

Lena: Ill wire Vector -> Kafka and add schema to `audit-configs`. Proposed example payload:
```
{
  "image": "gcr.io/redwood/foo@sha256:abcd1234",
  "digest": "sha256:abcd1234",
  "signer": "serviceAccount:image-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com",
  "cosign_key_version": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/image-signer/cryptoKeyVersions/1",
  "build_id": "bk-20230405-27",
  "env": "staging",
  "phase": "signed"
}
```
Mike: LGTM. RBAC needs two pieces: an IAM role CI assumes for signing, and a binding that allows that role to call `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToEncrypt`/`useToDecrypt` on the key. Ill draft policy and minimal principle-of-least-privilege permissions.

Jen: Buildkite agents must mint a transient SA token only during the sign step and revoke it immediately after. No long-lived keys on agents. Ill add the step wrapper.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline infra/image-bakes #987 completed  artifact: gcr.io/redwood/infra-base@sha256:abcd1234

security-bot: Sec review finding: require attestations (SBOM + in-toto) attached to images; block prod deploys without attestations. Enforcement rule attached.

Kevin: Define fallback: if KMS is unreachable, allow unsigned images in staging for up to 2 hours with a circuit-breaker metric; block prod always. SRE will surface the `kms_signer_availability` metric and a boolean `allow_unsigned_staging` flag.

Lena: Ill add a runbook flag `skip-sign-check` gated by incident id; will also route forensic logs to cold storage after 90 days.

Doug: Note from previous rebuild: token churn caused a surge in API auth errors. Ops oncall (@Mike or @Jen) should watch token rotation dashboards first hour.

Mike: Opening RBAC PR this afternoon with role, bindings, and preflight. Will include a smoke test shell snippet.

Sara: Smoke test expectations: cosign verify + start a pod with read-only rootfs. Example: 
```
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/image-signer gcr.io/redwood/foo@sha256:abcd1234
kubectl run --rm -it --image=gcr.io/redwood/foo:canary --read-only --restart=Never -- bash -c 'echo up && ls -la /'
```
Jen: Ive added a canary pipeline and patched staging. Buildkite step wraps cosign with KMS envelope flow and uses a short-lived token.

security-bot: Post-rollback hook: if rollback triggered, collect last 15 minutes of `audit.images` events and tag with incident id for investigators.

Lena: Scheduling: staging canary Mon 03:00 UTC (30m), prod phased Mon 11:00 UTC. Ill create invites and an alert playbook.

Mike: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/820 (RBAC + checklist). Assigning @Jen @Lena for reviews.

Sara: Keeping updates here. If anything odd during rollout ping #eng-oncall and include incident id. :thumbsup:

Mike: Running preflight now. Will report back.

Jen: Staging canary starting in 10.

deploy-bot: Staging canary deploy started  rollout r-20230405-1  watch: https://deploys.redwood.internal/r-20230405-1

Mike: Smoke tests passed on first canary pod. No elevated privileges observed. Monitoring for remaining 15m.

Lena: Audit events visible in `audit.images` for the canary. Example event captured: {"image":"gcr.io/redwood/foo@sha256:abcd1234","signer":"image-builder-sa","phase":"signed"}

Sara: Great. If green we proceed with phased prod. Thanks everyone.
